natures.name: Architect
natures.summary: Builds something of lasting value for others.

natures.name: Autocrat
natures.summary: Needs prominence, power, and control over others.

natures.name: Bon Vivant
natures.summary: Treats life and unlife as shallow and seeks pleasure anyway.

natures.name: Bravo
natures.summary: Believes might makes right and uses intimidation freely.

natures.name: Capitalist
natures.summary: Sees every person and need as part of a market to exploit.

natures.name: Caregiver
natures.summary: Protects, nurtures, and consoles others.

natures.name: Celebrant
natures.summary: Pursues a cause or passion because it brings genuine joy.

natures.name: Chameleon
natures.summary: Blends into roles and identities with practiced ease.

natures.name: Child
natures.summary: Remains immature, dependent, or emotionally unbalanced.

natures.name: Competitor
natures.summary: Treats every challenge as a contest that must be won.

natures.name: Conformist
natures.summary: Finds safety and meaning in following a stronger lead.

natures.name: Conniver
natures.summary: Uses manipulation and shortcuts instead of honest effort.

natures.name: Creep Show
natures.summary: Shocks and disgusts others to intimidate and control them.

natures.name: Curmudgeon
natures.summary: Sees flaws everywhere and expects disappointment.

natures.name: Dabbler
natures.summary: Bounces between fascinations without lasting focus.

natures.name: Deviant
natures.summary: Rejects the status quo and normal morality as sheep-think.

natures.name: Director
natures.summary: Seeks to impose order and guide action decisively.

natures.name: Enigma
natures.summary: Operates through baffling behavior that only later makes sense.

natures.name: Eye of the Storm
natures.summary: Exists calmly at the center of continual havoc.

natures.name: Fanatic
natures.summary: Subordinates everything to a single overriding cause.

natures.name: Gallant
natures.summary: Lives for attention, adoration, and performance.

natures.name: Guru
natures.summary: Draws others into spiritual or ideological pursuit.

natures.name: Idealist
natures.summary: Believes deeply in a higher goal or morality.

natures.name: Judge
natures.summary: Wants to improve the system through reason and evidence.

natures.name: Loner
natures.summary: Prefers distance, self-reliance, and separation from others.

natures.name: Martyr
natures.summary: Accepts suffering for a cause or another's benefit.

natures.name: Masochist
natures.summary: Defines self through endurance, pain, and denial.

natures.name: Monster
natures.summary: Embraces being Damned and acts with deliberate cruelty.

natures.name: Pedagogue
natures.summary: Needs to instruct, explain, and pass wisdom onward.

natures.name: Penitent
natures.summary: Seeks to atone for the harm of merely existing.

natures.name: Perfectionist
natures.summary: Demands flawless execution from self and others.

natures.name: Rebel
natures.summary: Rejects imposed rules and authority on principle.

natures.name: Rogue
natures.summary: Centers every scheme on personal advantage and style.

natures.name: Sadist
natures.summary: Finds meaning or pleasure in causing pain.

natures.name: Scientist
natures.summary: Approaches existence as a puzzle to understand.

natures.name: Sociopath
natures.summary: Sees the weak and inferior as expendable.

natures.name: Soldier
natures.summary: Obeys structure and mission, but in a personal way.

natures.name: Survivor
natures.summary: Endures anything and refuses to stay down.

natures.name: Thrill-Seeker
natures.summary: Lives for the rush of danger, novelty, and intensity.

natures.name: Traditionalist
natures.summary: Trusts established order, precedent, and continuity.

natures.name: Trickster
natures.summary: Uses wit, misdirection, and laughter to cut through pain.

natures.name: Visionary
natures.summary: Believes something greater exists beyond current conditions.

demeanors.name: Architect
demeanors.summary: Appears constructive, purposeful, and legacy-minded.

demeanors.name: Autocrat
demeanors.summary: Appears controlling, dominant, and title-conscious.

demeanors.name: Bon Vivant
demeanors.summary: Appears indulgent, charming, and pleasure-driven.

demeanors.name: Bravo
demeanors.summary: Appears dangerous, overbearing, and eager to cow others.

demeanors.name: Caregiver
demeanors.summary: Appears nurturing, protective, and emotionally available.

demeanors.name: Celebrant
demeanors.summary: Appears joyful, devoted, and energized by a cause.

demeanors.name: Chameleon
demeanors.summary: Appears adaptable and socially hard to pin down.

demeanors.name: Child
demeanors.summary: Appears needy, capricious, or disarmingly innocent.

demeanors.name: Competitor
demeanors.summary: Appears driven, ambitious, and eager to prove superiority.

demeanors.name: Conformist
demeanors.summary: Appears loyal, supportive, and comfortable following others.

demeanors.name: Conniver
demeanors.summary: Appears helpful while angling for advantage.

demeanors.name: Curmudgeon
demeanors.summary: Appears bitter, skeptical, and unimpressed.

demeanors.name: Director
demeanors.summary: Appears orderly, authoritative, and task-focused.

demeanors.name: Fanatic
demeanors.summary: Appears consumed by a cause larger than immediate comfort.

demeanors.name: Gallant
demeanors.summary: Appears dramatic, magnetic, and hungry for attention.

demeanors.name: Idealist
demeanors.summary: Appears principled, hopeful, and value-driven.

demeanors.name: Judge
demeanors.summary: Appears analytical, fair-minded, and evidence-led.

demeanors.name: Loner
demeanors.summary: Appears isolated, guarded, and self-contained.

demeanors.name: Martyr
demeanors.summary: Appears burdened yet willing to bear pain for others.

demeanors.name: Pedagogue
demeanors.summary: Appears instructive, verbose, and eager to teach.

demeanors.name: Penitent
demeanors.summary: Appears remorseful, burdened, and self-denying.

demeanors.name: Rebel
demeanors.summary: Appears defiant, disruptive, and impossible to domesticate.

demeanors.name: Scientist
demeanors.summary: Appears curious, detached, and methodical.

demeanors.name: Soldier
demeanors.summary: Appears disciplined, reliable, and mission-centered.

demeanors.name: Survivor
demeanors.summary: Appears resilient, practical, and hard to break.

demeanors.name: Traditionalist
demeanors.summary: Appears respectful of hierarchy, custom, and old forms.

demeanors.name: Trickster
demeanors.summary: Appears playful, slippery, and fond of misdirection.

demeanors.name: Visionary
demeanors.summary: Appears driven by possibility beyond the immediate night.
